crossRefs.note: Neither shall you swear by your head, for you can’t make one hair white or black.
“Surely every man walks like a shadow. Surely they busy themselves in vain. He heaps up, and doesn’t know who shall…
I know that whatever God does, it shall be forever. Nothing can be added to it, nor anything taken from it; and God has…
Which of you by being anxious can add a cubit to his height?
If then you aren’t able to do even the least things, why are you anxious about the rest?
But now God has set the members, each one of them, in the body, just as he desired.

parallels.note: Which of you by being anxious can add a cubit to his height?

translations.web: “Which of you, by being anxious, can add one moment to his lifespan?
translations.bsb: Who of you by worrying can add a single hour to his life?
translations.kjv: Which of you by taking thought can add one cubit unto his stature?
translations.asv: And which of you by being anxious can add one cubit unto the measure of his life?
